introduce: Lie on your right side with head resting on your right hand. \n\nThen put your left foot forward on the floor. Lift your right leg up and down.
name: BOTTOM LEG LIFT RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Tighten your core.
Keep your upper body still.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
If you feel it's too easy, lift your leg as high as you can.
It works if you feel your bottom inner thigh burning.
This exercise is good for your inner thighs.

introduce: Lie on your left side with your head resting on your left hand. \n\nThen put your right foot forward on the floor. Lift your left leg up and down.
name: BOTTOM LEG LIFT LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Tighten your core.
Keep your upper body still.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
If you feel it's too easy, lift your leg as high as you can.
It works if you feel your bottom inner thigh burning.
This exercise is good for your inner thighs.

introduce: Start with your feet shoulder width apart. Bend your legs slightly and lean your upper body forward. \n\nPut your hands in front of you to keep balance, then run in place quickly.
name: QUICK FEET

tips.text: Keep your upper body still.
Keep your core tight.
Take steady and deep breaths.
To make it harder, do the quick steps as fast as you can.
You can feel your heart rate up.
Maintain steady, controlled breathing throughout the exercise.
This exercise targets your quadriceps and calves.
It's a great exercise to improve your speed and agility.

introduce: Stand up on the floor, then run in place while kicking your heel up to touch your butt with each step.\n\nTry to do it as fast as you can. It\'s a great exercise for the gluteus and hamstrings.
name: BUTT KICKS

tips.text: Please keep your chest up.
Please try to get your feet to touch your hips.
Please pull your shoulders back.
Please tighten your abs.
Please land on your toes.
Please try to do it as fast as you can.
Try to maintain a steady, rhythmic breathing pattern throughout the exercise.
Always remember to inhale deeply through the nose and exhale fully through the mouth.
It’s a cardio exercise that can strengthen your gluteus and hamstrings.

introduce:
Sit on the floor with your legs bent together and your hands under your shoulders to support your body. 

Then lift one leg up while lifting your hips off the floor as high as you can. Switch to the other leg and repeat.

Push yourself up with your hips instead of your back. It's a great exercise for the gluteus.
name: CRAB KICKS

tips.text: Please push yourself up with your hips instead of your back.
Please lift your hips off the floor as high as you can.
To make it more of a challenge, you can alternately kick your feet in the air.
Exhale as you lift your body up and kick your legs out.
Inhale as you bring your legs back in and lower your body.
This exercise works the back of your thighs, your shoulders, your abs, and especially your gluteus.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended and your elbows directly under your shoulders.

 Lift your left leg up at a 45 degree angle while reaching your right arm over to your left side.

 Then slowly go back to the starting position. Repeat several times, and then switch to the other side.
name: RECLINED OBLIQUE TWIST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please do this slowly to get better results.
Please keep your legs straight.
If you feel the exercise is too hard, you can put your legs on the floor.
If you feel the exercise is too easy, you can lift both legs.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise tones your obliques, abs and thighs.

introduce:
Stand with your feet 1.5 times shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing outward. Place your hands by your sides.

Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the floor. And bring your hands together in front of your chest.

Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
name: SUMO SQUAT

tips.text: Keep your core tight.
Keep your chest up and back straight.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hand.
This exercise targets all the muscles of your lower body.

introduce:
Lie on your back with legs extended. 

Inhale, lift your left knee and grab it with both hands.  Exhale slowly, pull your left knee towards your chest, keeping your right leg straight.

Hold this position for a few seconds, breathing smoothly and steadily.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw the knee closer to your chest.

introduce:
Lie on your back with legs extended. 

Inhale, lift your right knee and grab it with both hands.  Exhale slowly, pull your right knee towards your chest, keeping your left leg straight.

Hold this position for a few seconds, breathing smoothly and steadily.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw the knee closer to your chest.

introduce:
Hold the chair back with your left hand for balance.

Exhale, slowly lift your right leg out to the right side as high as possible.

Inhale, slowly lower it back down. Repeat.
name: RIGHT LEG LATERAL RAISE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Pull your shoulders back.
Please tighten your core.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.
Please keep your upper body still.
This exercise works the lateral muscles on your legs.

introduce:
Hold the chair back with your right hand for balance.

Exhale, slowly lift your left leg out to the left side as high as possible.

Inhale, slowly lower it back down. Repeat.
name: LEFT LEG LATERAL RAISE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Pull your shoulders back.
Please tighten your core.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.
Please keep your upper body still.
This exercise works the lateral muscles on your legs.
